newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel suspended to avoid speculation.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel suspended to avoid speculation.

text.p: A spokeswoman for Eurotunnel SA/Plc said on Monday that the company had asked for trading in its shares to be suspended in London and Paris to avoid "speculation."
"We decided to ask for the suspension to avoid speculation on the shares," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
The company planned to make a statement either on Monday or Tuesday, she added.
The mandate for two Paris court-appointed mediators expires today. Robert Badinter and Lord Wakeham have been helping Eurotunnel negotiate a debt restructuring with its bankers.
The SBF French stockmarkets association said in a statement that trading in Eurotunnel shares and options was suspended until further notice, pending a statement from the company.

Eurotunnel has been trying to negotiate a refinancing of more than 62 billion francs in junior-ranked bank debt. It froze interest payment on the bank loans owed to some 225 banks in September last year.
